transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um, yeah, thanks. I guess what made me come in is that I just keep feeling like I ruined things for everybody. I'm doing my pipefitting apprenticeship right now, and lately I just feel like a total fake. Like I'm letting my family down, and the younger apprentices down, over... well, over stuff I know other people would probably just fix and move on from. But it's just been really weighing on me.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things the way you used to, like hobbies or activities you used to like?

Yeah, I definitely have. Um... lately, I can just walk right past my sketchbook without picking it up, or skip volleyball entirely. I've even been ignoring the group texts from my volunteer group. It's weird because those used to be the things that made me feel like myself. But now... I don't know, I just don't really feel much of anything about them.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or blaming yourself for things that aren’t entirely your fault?

Yeah, that's exactly it. Like I mentioned when I first sat down, I just keep feeling like I've ruined things for everybody. I'm in this pipefitting apprenticeship, and I just feel like a total fake. I look at the younger apprentices, and my family, and I just feel like I'm letting them all down. And it's over stuff that... I mean, I know other people would probably just fix the mistake and move on. But for me, I just can't stop blaming myself for it. It just hangs over me.
Have you noticed that you're feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even if you're not doing anything physically draining?

No, I haven't really noticed that. I mean, my job is pretty physical, so I get tired from being at work, but... if I'm not doing anything heavy, I don't feel extra drained or anything. My energy levels are actually pretty normal, I think.
Have you been having trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up earlier than usual lately?

Yeah, I have. Um... for a while there, I was actually getting by on just three or four hours a night, and I'd still show up completely wired for the job and my classes. But now it's different. Now I either just can't fall asleep at all, or I wake up way before my alarm goes off, and I just feel like I never even rested.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?

No, I wouldn't really say I feel depressed. I mean... I get really down on myself about my mistakes, like I was saying before, but I don't feel sad or depressed all day long. I'm not sitting around crying or anything. It's more just the frustration and the guilt, but my actual mood isn't really down like that.
Have you noticed that you don’t get any pleasure or satisfaction out of things you used to enjoy, like your sketchbook or volleyball?

Yeah, I have. Um... lately I can just walk right past my sketchbook without even picking it up. I've been skipping volleyball, too, and... I just ignore the group texts from my volunteer group without really feeling much of anything about it. It's weird because those used to be the things that made me feel like myself, you know? But now I just don't get anything out of them.
Have you been feeling worthless or experiencing excessive guilt almost every day lately?

Yeah, that's actually the main reason I decided to come in. I just keep feeling like I've ruined things for everybody. I feel like I'm a complete fake in my apprenticeship, and I get this overwhelming guilt that I've let my family down, and even the younger apprentices. And the thing is, it's over stuff that... I know other people would probably just fix and move on from. But I just can't seem to let it go.
Have you been having trouble focusing on tasks, or feeling like your mind goes blank a lot lately?

No, not really. I mean, I can still focus on my work at the apprenticeship just fine. My mind doesn't really go blank or anything like that. I just... I focus on the mistakes I make, but the actual concentrating part isn't an issue.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or unable to sit still lately?

Yeah, actually. On the job, I'll catch myself moving really slow. It's like it takes extra effort just to climb down to get a fitting, or even just to answer a question when the foreman talks to me. It's gotten to the point where a few people have asked if I'm sick or hungover because I'm just dragging so much.
Have you completely lost interest in your sketchbook, volleyball, or your volunteer group, or do you still care about them but just can't bring yourself to participate?

I think I've completely lost interest. Lately, I can just walk right past my sketchbook, or skip volleyball, and I'll ignore the texts from my volunteer group without really feeling much of anything. It's strange, because those used to be the things that made me feel like myself, but right now I just don't care about them at all.
Have you had days where you felt down or low, not just guilty or frustrated, and if so, how often have you felt that way?

No, I wouldn't say I've felt down or low like that. I mean, I get frustrated with myself, like I said, and I feel bad about the mistakes I'm making at work, but it's not really a sad or down feeling. It's just... I'm not feeling much of anything, really, except tired and annoyed with myself. But no, not just generally down or depressed.
Have you felt down or in a low mood for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row lately?
No, like I was just saying, I haven't really felt down or sad like that. So, no, definitely not every day for two weeks. It's really just that numb, tired feeling I mentioned, but not a low mood.
Have you ever felt down or in a low mood for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row at any point during the last few months?

No, not in the last few months either. Um, I really haven't had that kind of sad or down feeling at all recently. It's... yeah, it's really just been that lack of caring about things, like I mentioned, but not an actual low mood.
Have you completely stopped caring about your sketchbook, volleyball, or your volunteer group for at least two weeks in a row lately?

Yeah, I have. It's been going on for a while now, definitely more than two weeks. Lately, I can just walk right past my sketchbook and not even care. I've been skipping volleyball, and I just ignore the texts from my volunteer group. It's weird because those used to be the things that actually made me feel like myself, but now... I just don't feel much of anything about them.
Have you completely stopped caring about or feeling any pleasure from *all* activities, including things outside of your sketchbook, volleyball, or volunteer group?

No, um, not everything. I wouldn't say it's all activities. I still care about some things... like, I still get some enjoyment out of just my regular day-to-day stuff, or watching a show, things like that. It's really just those specific hobbies I told you about that I've completely dropped.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt down or in a low mood most of the day, nearly every day, even if it wasn’t recently?
No, um, I don't think so. I've never really had a time where I felt sad or down like that for two whole weeks, even further back. It's just not really something I've dealt with.
Have you noticed that you don't get any pleasure or satisfaction out of *any* activities lately, even things you used to enjoy outside of your sketchbook, volleyball, or volunteer group?

No, like I said, it's not everything. I mean, I still get some enjoyment out of other stuff. It's really just those main hobbies I mentioned that I've stopped caring about. I still feel okay doing regular things.
Have you noticed that you don't get any pleasure or satisfaction out of *any* activities lately, even things you used to enjoy outside of your sketchbook, volleyball, or volunteer group?

Um, I think you just asked me that, right? But no, it's really not everything. Like I just mentioned, I still get satisfaction out of my regular day-to-day stuff. It's literally just those three main hobbies I dropped. I still feel fine doing other things, so it's definitely not all activities.
Have you found that you don’t enjoy *any* activities at all anymore, even things you used to like outside of your hobbies, like spending time with friends or watching your favorite shows?

I feel like we're going in circles a bit here. Like I said before, it's really just the sketchbook, the volleyball, and the volunteering. I still hang out with my friends, I still watch TV... I enjoy all that stuff just fine. It's not everything, just those specific hobbies I dropped.

inference.note: The patient does not report feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, even for a two-week period, which rules out current major depressive episodes (F32.0, F32.1, F32.2). The chronic nature of symptoms and persistence beyond a single episode supports the likelihood of recurrent depressive disorder. However, the lack of pervasive anhedonia and absence of a clearly depressed mood for two weeks makes ruling out F33 subcodes premature, though the list is narrowed to these three.

opening_question.intent: Establish the patient's reason for seeking psychiatric evaluation
opening_question.question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient meets criteria for a major depressive episode with atypical features, characterized by mood reactivity (loss of pleasure only in specific domains), significant functional impairment, and neurovegetative symptoms (sleep disturbance and psychomotor slowing). The absence of persistent depressed mood and lack of full anhedonia preclude a more severe episode classification. The chronicity and recurrent nature of symptoms support a diagnosis of recurrent depressive disorder, current episode severe with atypical features.
